raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

This affects prefill serving of GLM-5.3-Flash, which uses the pooled DSA `IndexerKPool`.

`IndexerKPool._kpool_topk_by_row_chunks` calls `fp8_mqa_logits` with `clean_logits=True`, which `torch.full(-inf)`-initializes the full `[query rows x concatenated pooled KV rows]` FP32 logits buffer before the scorer writes each row's valid range. The buffer can be several GiB at long context.

The downstream KPool top-k already receives `row_starts` and `pool_lens` and reads only `score[row, row_start : row_start + pool_len]`. Initializing positions outside those ranges is therefore redundant. This is the KPool equivalent of the non-pooled indexer optimization merged in #28757.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa/dsa_indexer_kpool.py`: pass `clean_logits=False` to the ragged KPool MQA-logits call. Valid logits are unchanged; positions outside each row's declared range remain uninitialized and are not read by KPool top-k.
- Extend the gfx950 real-kernel test through the production KPool top-k transform at GLM-5.3-Flash geometry (`32 x 128`, KPool 4, token top-k 2048).
- Make KPool chunking unit tests require `clean_logits=False` on both ROCm/AITER and CUDA/DeepGEMM paths.

## Accuracy Tests

Full GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 GSM8K on snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`. The baseline is frozen integrated source `4a2714fbe3`; the candidate is `f6b4661f24`, which adds only #44824. Both include #38764 at `ed418ce926` and #41615 at `acca6a72db`, use `aiter_sparse_mla`, `SGLANG_OPT_GLM53_KDA_PTPC_MODULES=qkv_proj,f_a_proj,g_a_proj,o_proj`, AITER `e7d2453f25`, separate fresh caches, thinking enabled, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, and seed 0.

| Configuration | Score | Stop rate | Truncated rate | Error rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| TP4 baseline — `clean_logits=True` | 97.19% | 99.92% | 0.08% | 0.00% |
| TP4 candidate — `clean_logits=False` | 96.74% | 100.00% | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| TP8 baseline — `clean_logits=True` | 96.36% | 99.47% | 0.53% | 0.00% |
| TP8 candidate — `clean_logits=False` | 97.19% | 99.70% | 0.30% | 0.00% |

TP4 used a 65,536-token context, 64 evaluator threads, and 32,768 maximum output tokens. TP8 used a 131,072-token context, 1,200 evaluator threads, and 4,096 maximum output tokens. All four runs completed 1,319 questions without errors; the score deltas are within single-pass sampling variation.

The real-kernel tests produced identical selected KV sets with `clean_logits=True` and `False` through both the ordinary masked top-k and KPool fused top-k paths. `test_dsa_skip_logits_clean.py`: 2 passed. `test_kpool_stream_scheduling.py`: 13 passed.

## Speed Benchmarks

The isolated GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 MQA scorer improves 7.2% to 24.8% across the measured `H=32`, `D=128` cells. The tables below check end-to-end serving for regressions; no end-to-end improvement is claimed.

### End-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 TP4, random 8K input / 1K output. Both arms use the same frozen integrated stack and differ only by #44824.

A. Baseline — `clean_logits=True`:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 620.69 | 7.885 | 8,778.87 | 466.33 |
| 8 | 944.08 | 8.630 | 10,188.38 | 803.46 |
| 16 | 1,589.07 | 9.595 | 12,464.75 | 1,313.27 |
| 32 | 2,875.93 | 10.955 | 16,423.81 | 1,996.15 |
| 64 | 5,448.35 | 13.275 | 24,012.66 | 2,729.07 |

B. This PR — `clean_logits=False` (delta versus baseline):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 620.77 | +0.01% | 7.880 | -0.06% | 8,780.90 | +0.02% | 466.30 | -0.01% |
| 8 | 944.02 | -0.01% | 8.625 | -0.06% | 10,184.90 | -0.03% | 804.03 | +0.07% |
| 16 | 1,586.54 | -0.16% | 9.595 | +0.00% | 12,450.38 | -0.12% | 1,313.22 | -0.00% |
| 32 | 2,870.99 | -0.17% | 10.960 | +0.05% | 16,409.26 | -0.09% | 1,995.59 | -0.03% |
| 64 | 5,443.05 | -0.10% | 13.325 | +0.38% | 24,002.39 | -0.04% | 2,730.42 | +0.05% |

### TP8 end-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 TP8, random 8K input / 1K output. Both arms use the same frozen integrated stack and differ only by #44824.

A. Baseline — `clean_logits=True`:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 518.13 | 7.330 | 8,075.44 | 506.99 |
| 8 | 784.39 | 7.915 | 9,202.28 | 889.89 |
| 16 | 1,314.07 | 8.210 | 10,576.63 | 1,548.31 |
| 32 | 2,369.86 | 9.285 | 13,776.57 | 2,377.64 |
| 64 | 4,484.37 | 10.810 | 19,584.59 | 3,345.61 |

B. This PR — `clean_logits=False` (delta versus baseline):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 514.09 | -0.78% | 7.340 | +0.14% | 8,078.49 | +0.04% | 506.69 | -0.06% |
| 8 | 779.18 | -0.66% | 7.920 | +0.06% | 9,202.87 | +0.01% | 889.72 | -0.02% |
| 16 | 1,310.57 | -0.27% | 8.215 | +0.06% | 10,574.13 | -0.02% | 1,548.15 | -0.01% |
| 32 | 2,366.46 | -0.14% | 9.305 | +0.22% | 13,787.36 | +0.08% | 2,376.15 | -0.06% |
| 64 | 4,478.95 | -0.12% | 10.810 | +0.00% | 19,568.82 | -0.08% | 3,347.92 | +0.07% |

TP4 and TP8 are flat within 0.4%, confirming no end-to-end regression.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing documentation change is needed.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
